description: Send a WhatsApp message via Brevo (POST /whatsapp/sendMessage). This SENDS to outside recipients immediately — confirm recipients and content with the human first. Required: senderNumber, contactNumbers (array), and templateId (with params) or text (only inside the 24 h window).

params.description: Parameters filled into the WhatsApp template

senderNumber.description: WhatsApp sender number registered in Brevo

templateId.description: Brevo WhatsApp template ID to send

text.description: Free text; only allowed within the 24 h window

name: send_brevo_whatsapp
